# Introduction
This document consists of all preprocessing prior to PLS-DA model. The data will split into training and test set and based on the country origin of the samples.

## Load the dataset

```{r}
# Load the dataset
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
X_initial <- list(
    intact = read_excel("data/nirs_intact.xlsx") %>%
    column_to_rownames("Sample_ID") %>% dplyr::select(-(1:12), -("400":"1099.5")),
    ground = read_excel("data/nirs_milled.xlsx") %>%
    column_to_rownames("Sample_ID") %>% dplyr::select(-("400":"1099.5"))
)
y_initial <- read_excel("data/nirs_intact.xlsx") %>%
    column_to_rownames("Sample_ID") %>% dplyr::select(1:12)

# transform Deoxynivalenol and Total DON to binary variables based on the threshold of 1000 ppb and 1000 ppb, respectively.
# the uncertainty level of DON is 30% (Ur)
# C: compliant, NC: non-compliant, U: uncertain
uncertainty <- 0.3
y_initial <- y_initial %>%
    mutate(DON_2 = ifelse(Deoxynivalenol < 1000, "C", "NC"),
           Total_DON_2 = ifelse(`Total DON` < 1000, "C", "NC"))
y_initial <- y_initial %>%
    mutate(DON_4 = ifelse(Deoxynivalenol < (1000 * (1 - uncertainty)), "C", ifelse(Deoxynivalenol > (1000 * (1 + uncertainty)), "NC", ifelse(Deoxynivalenol < (1000 * (1 + uncertainty)) & Deoxynivalenol > 1000, "UNC", "UC"))),
           Total_DON_4 = ifelse(`Total DON` < (1000 * (1 - uncertainty)), "C", ifelse(`Total DON` > (1000 * (1 + uncertainty)), "NC", ifelse(`Total DON` < (1000 * (1 + uncertainty)) & `Total DON` > 1000, "UNC", "UC"))))
cols <- c("year", "Country", "DON_2", "Total_DON_2", "DON_4", "Total_DON_4")
y_initial[cols] <- lapply(y_initial[cols], as.factor)
str(y_initial)
```

## Analysis on combined dataset
### Outlier detection using PCA
Outlier detection using Hotelling's T-squared statistic and Q-residuals with the ncomp explained > 99%. The samples that exceed the 95% confidence limit in either of these statistics are considered outliers.

```{r}
library(mdatools)
outliers_pca_total <- lapply(X_initial, function(X) {
    pca_model <- pca(X, ncomp = 3, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
})

#plotting the PCA results to visualize outliers
## intact samples
plotCumVariance(outliers_pca_total$intact, show.labels = TRUE)
plotDistances(outliers_pca_total$intact, norm = FALSE, show.labels = TRUE) # 99631 is an outlier

## ground samples
plotCumVariance(outliers_pca_total$ground, show.labels = TRUE)
plotDistances(outliers_pca_total$ground, show.labels = TRUE) # AT5-8185-05 is an outlier


## remove the outliers from the all datasets
X_total_cleaned <- lapply(X_initial, function(X){
    X[!(rownames(X) %in% c("99631", "AT5-8185-05")), ]
})
y_total_cleaned <- y_initial[!(rownames(y_initial) %in% c("99631", "AT5-8185-05")), ]
```

### Plotting the spectra
```{r}
## apply spectral preprocessing methods to the cleaned datasets
library(prospectr)
X_total_prep <- lapply(X_total_cleaned, function(df) {
  list(
    Raw = df,
    SNV = standardNormalVariate(savitzkyGolay(df, m = 0, p = 2, w = 15)),
    D1  = savitzkyGolay(df, m = 1, p = 2, w = 15)
  )
})

## long format for plotting
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)
X_total_long <- lapply(X_total_prep, function(grinding) {
    lapply(grinding, function(X) {
        X %>% as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column("Sample_ID") %>%
        melt(id.vars = "Sample_ID", variable.name = "Wavelength", value.name = "Reflectance") %>%
        left_join(y_total_cleaned %>% rownames_to_column("Sample_ID") %>% select(Sample_ID, year, Country, DON_2, DON_4, Total_DON_2, Total_DON_4), by = "Sample_ID")
    })
})

## import the function for plotting the spectra
source("./utils/plotting.R")
# Define the colors for the variables
meta_vars <- c("Country", "year", "DON_2", "Total_DON_2", "DON_4", "Total_DON_4")
lapply(meta_vars, function(var) {
  plot_list <- lapply(names(X_total_long), function(grp) {
    lapply(names(X_total_long[[grp]]), function(meth) {
      y_label <- if (meth == "D1") {
        expression(frac(d(log(1/R)), d*lambda))
      } else {
        "log (1/R)"
      }
      title <- paste0(toupper(grp), " - ", meth)
      plot_spectra(
        X_total_long[[grp]][[meth]],
        title = title,
        y_label = y_label,
        color = var
      )
    })
  }) %>% unlist(recursive = FALSE)

  # Create the grid
  combined_plot <- ggarrange(
    plotlist = plot_list,
    ncol = 3, nrow = 2,
    align = "hv", common.legend = TRUE, legend = "top"
  )
  
  # Save using the variable name in the filename
  ggsave(paste0("./figures/preprocessing/", var, "_spectra.png"), 
         combined_plot, width = 16, height = 10)
})

## Plotting the raw spectra colored by country
source("./utils/plotting.R")
raw_spectra_country <- ggplot(X_total_long$intact$Raw, aes(x = as.numeric(as.character(Wavelength)), y = Reflectance, group = Sample_ID, color = Country)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(x = "Wavelength (nm)", y = "log (1/R)") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Austria" = "#40B0A6", "France" = "#E1BE6A")) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(), 
          legend.position = "top")
ggsave("./figures/preprocessing/Raw_spectra_Country.svg", raw_spectra_country, width = 5, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 600)

#Plotting the raw spectra colored by DON_4
raw_spectra_DON_4 <- ggplot(X_total_long$intact$Raw, aes(x = as.numeric(as.character(Wavelength)), y = Reflectance, group = Sample_ID, color = DON_4)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(x = "Wavelength (nm)", y = "log (1/R)") +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("C" = "#1982c4", "UC" = "#b6d5e9", "UNC" = "#f7c1bb", "NC" = "#ef233c")) +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(), 
          legend.position = "top")
ggsave("./figures/preprocessing/Raw_spectra_DON_4.svg", raw_spectra_DON_4, width = 5, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 600)

library(ggplot2)
spectra_SNV <- ggplot(X_total_long$intact$SNV, aes(x = as.numeric(as.character(Wavelength)), y = Reflectance, group = Sample_ID)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +

spectra_D1 <- ggplot(X_total_long$intact$D1, aes(x = as.numeric(as.character(Wavelength)), y = Reflectance, group = Sample_ID)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("black")) +
    labs(x = "Wavelength (nm)", y = expression(frac(d(log(1/R)), d*lambda))) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(), 
          legend.position = "top",
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_blank())

spectra_D1
```

### Plotting the pca scores
```{r}
#import the library
library(mdatools)
pca_total_long <- lapply(X_total_prep, function(grinding) {
    lapply(grinding, function(X) {
        #run pca
        model <- pca(X, ncomp = 3, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
        
        model$calres$scores %>% as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column("Sample_ID") %>%
        left_join(y_total_cleaned %>% rownames_to_column("Sample_ID") %>% 
        dplyr::select(Sample_ID, year, Country, DON_2, DON_4, Total_DON_2, Total_DON_4), by = "Sample_ID")
    })
})

pca_var_total_long <- lapply(X_total_prep, function(grinding) {
    lapply(grinding, function(X) {
        #run pca
        model <- pca(X, ncomp = 3, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
        return(model$calres$expvar)
    })
})

# Define the colors for the variables
meta_vars <- c("year", "DON_2", "Total_DON_2", "DON_4", "Total_DON_4")
source("./utils/plotting.R")
lapply(meta_vars, function(var) {
  plot_list <- lapply(names(pca_total_long), function(grp) {
    lapply(names(X_total_long[[grp]]), function(meth) {
        plot_pca(
            pca_total_long[[grp]][[meth]],
            pca_var_total_long[[grp]][[meth]],
            title = paste0(toupper(grp), " - ", meth),
            color = var,
            shape = "Country"
        )
        }) 
  })%>% unlist(recursive = FALSE)

  # Create the grid
  combined_plot <- ggarrange(
    plotlist = plot_list,
    ncol = 3, nrow = 2,
    align = "hv", common.legend = TRUE, legend = "top"
  )
  
  # Save using the variable name in the filename
  ggsave(paste0("./figures/PCA/", var, "_pca.svg"), 
         combined_plot, width = 16, height = 10)
})

# PCA of Ground SNV colored by DON_4 and shaped by country
source("./utils/plotting.R")
pca_ground_snv <- plot_pca(
    pca_total_long$ground$SNV,
    pca_var_total_long$ground$SNV,
    title = NULL,
    color = "DON_4",
    shape = "Country"
)
ggsave("./figures/PCA/Ground_SNV_pca_DON_4_Country.svg", pca_ground_snv, width = 5, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```

## Analysis on Austrian samples
### outlier detection using PCA

```{r}
# Subset the data for Austrian samples
X_austria <- lapply(X_initial, function(X) {
    X[y_initial$Country == "Austria", ]
})

outliers_pca_austria <- lapply(X_austria, function(X) {
    pca_model <- pca(X, ncomp = 2, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
})

#plotting the PCA results to visualize outliers
## intact samples
plotCumVariance(outliers_pca_austria$intact, show.labels = TRUE)
plotDistances(outliers_pca_austria$intact, show.labels = TRUE) # 99631 is an outlier

## ground samples
plotCumVariance(outliers_pca_austria$ground, show.labels = TRUE)
plotDistances(outliers_pca_austria$ground, show.labels = TRUE) # 99022 and 99098 are outliers

## Plotting the PCA distance plots
svg(filename = "./figures/PLS_DA/combined_outliers_plot.svg", width = 10, height = 7)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
## For total dataset
plotDistances(outliers_pca_total$intact, 
              show.labels = TRUE, 
              main = "Austrian and French Intact Wheats")
mtext("A", side = 3, adj = 0, line = 1.5, cex = 1.2, font = 2)

plotDistances(outliers_pca_total$ground, 
              show.labels = TRUE, 
              main = "Austrian and French Ground Wheats")
mtext("B", side = 3, adj = 0, line = 1.5, cex = 1.2, font = 2)

# For Austrian dataset
plotDistances(outliers_pca_austria$intact, 
              show.labels = TRUE, 
              main = "Austrian Intact Wheats") 
mtext("C", side = 3, adj = 0, line = 1.5, cex = 1.2, font = 2)

plotDistances(outliers_pca_austria$ground, 
              show.labels = TRUE, 
              main = "Austrian Ground Wheats")

# Reset the plotting window

dev.off()

## remove the outliers from the all datasets
X_austria_cleaned <- lapply(X_austria, function(X){
    X[!(rownames(X) %in% c("99631", "99022", "99098")), ]
```

## Plotting the distribution of the metadata variables
### Plot for the combined dataset

```{r}
## Plot the distribution of the country variable
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
source("./utils/plotting.R")
y_total_cleaned$DON_4 <- factor(y_total_cleaned$DON_4, levels = c("C", "UC", "UNC", "NC"))
y_total_cleaned$Total_DON_4 <- factor(y_total_cleaned$Total_DON_4, levels = c("C", "UC", "UNC", "NC"))

df_boxplot <- y_total_cleaned %>%
  dplyr::select(Country, Deoxynivalenol, `Total DON`, DON_4, Total_DON_4) %>%
  rename(
    DON_Value = Deoxynivalenol,
    TotalDON_Value = `Total DON`,
    DON_Class = DON_4,
    TotalDON_Class = Total_DON_4
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Country,
    names_to = c("Toxin_Type", ".value"),
    names_sep = "_"
  )
df_boxplot$certainty <- ifelse(df_boxplot$Class == "UNC" | df_boxplot$Class == "UC", "Uncertain", "Certain")

# Load the required visualization library
library(scales)
df_boxplot$Toxin_Type <- factor(df_boxplot$Toxin_Type, levels = c("DON", "TotalDON"))

threshold_limits <- data.frame(
  Toxin_Type = factor(c("DON", "TotalDON"), levels = c("DON", "TotalDON")),
  Limit = c(1000)
)

boxplot_DON<- ggplot(df_boxplot, aes(x = Country, y = Value)) + 
                  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5, fill = "white", color = "black") +
                  geom_jitter(aes(color = Class), width = 0.15, 
                              alpha = 0.8, size = 2.5) +
                  facet_wrap(~ Toxin_Type, labeller = as_labeller(c("DON" = "DON", "TotalDON" = "Total DON"))) +
                  geom_hline(data = threshold_limits, aes(yintercept = Limit), 
                            color = "gray", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
                  scale_color_manual(
                    values = c("C" = "#1982c4", "NC" = "#ef233c", "UC" = "#b6d5e9", "UNC" = "#f7c1bb"),
                    labels = c("C" = "Compliant (C)", 
                              "NC" = "Non-Compliant (NC)", 
                              "UC" = "Uncertain Compliant (UC)", 
                              "UNC" = "Uncertain Non-Compliant (UNC)")
                  ) + 
                  scale_y_continuous(trans = "sqrt", 
                                    breaks = c(0, 100, 1000, 5000, 10000, 15000, 20000)) +
                  
                  theme_classic() +
                  labs(
                    y = "Concentration (ppb)",
                    x = "",
                    color = "Classification"  
                  ) +
                  theme(
                    legend.position = "top",
                    legend.title = element_blank(),
                    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
                    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
                    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
                    legend.text = element_text(size = 12), 
                    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
                    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines") 
                  )
boxplot_DON
ggsave("./figures/PLS_DA/Distribution_Country_Boxplot.svg", boxplot_DON, width = 10.5, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 600)



## Create a stacked bar plot to show the distribution of compliant, non-compliant and uncertain samples for DON and Total DON in total and Austrian dataset
library(tidyr)
stacked_df <- bind_rows(
  y_total_cleaned  %>% mutate(Variable = "All Dataset"),
  y_total_cleaned %>% filter(Country == "France") %>% mutate(Variable = "French Dataset"),
  y_austria_cleaned %>% mutate(Variable = "Austrian Dataset")
) %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, DON_4, Total_DON_4) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(DON_4, Total_DON_4),
    names_to = "Toxin_Type",
    values_to = "Classification"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Toxin_Type = dplyr::recode(
      Toxin_Type,
      DON_4 = "DON",
      Total_DON_4 = "Total DON"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Variable, Toxin_Type, Classification) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop")%>%
  group_by(Variable, Toxin_Type) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = Count / sum(Count),
    Label = scales::percent(Percent, accuracy = 0.1)
  )
stacked_df$Classification <- factor(stacked_df$Classification, levels = c("C", "UC", "UNC", "NC"))

library(ggplot2)
stacked_plot <- ggplot(stacked_df, aes(x = Toxin_Type, y = Count, fill = Classification)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "C" = "#1982c4",
      "NC" = "#ef233c",
      "UC" = "#b6d5e9",
      "UNC" = "#f7c1bb"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Toxin Type",
    y = "Samples Proportion",
    fill = "Classification"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  )
stacked_plot
ggsave("./figures/PLS_DA/Distribution_Stacked_Bar.svg", stacked_plot, width = 7, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 600)

## Cross-label between DON and Total DON
y_total_cleaned$cross_label <- ifelse(
  y_total_cleaned$DON_2 == "C" & y_total_cleaned$Total_DON_2 == "NC", "Cross-Positive",
  ifelse(
    y_total_cleaned$DON_2 == "NC" & y_total_cleaned$Total_DON_2 == "C", "Cross-Negative",
    "Consistent"
  )
)

# select only the cross-Negative and cross-positive samples and make the rownmames as the sample ID
cross_samples <- y_total_cleaned %>%
  filter(cross_label != "Consistent") %>%
  dplyr::select(cross_label, DON = Deoxynivalenol, Total_DON = `Total DON`) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample_ID")
#melt the data for plotting
library(reshape2)
cross_samples_long <- melt(cross_samples, id.vars = c("Sample_ID", "cross_label"), measure.vars = c("DON", "Total_DON"), variable.name = "DON_Type", value.name = "DON_Value")

cross_plot <- ggplot(cross_samples_long, aes(x = Sample_ID, y = DON_Value, color = DON_Type)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5) ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = DON_Value * 0.7, ymax = DON_Value * 1.3), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5) ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1000, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 1000, label = "EC Threshold", vjust = -0.5, hjust = -0.1, color = "gray30", fontface = "bold") +
  
  labs(x = "Sample ID", 
       y = "Concentration (ppb)") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(500, max(cross_samples_long$DON_Value) * 1.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("DON" = "#FFC20A", "Total_DON" = "#0C7BDC"), labels = c("DON" = "DON", "Total_DON" = "Total DON")) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 120, 10, 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10))
cross_plot
#export the plot
ggsave("./figures/PLS_DA/Cross_label_samples.svg", cross_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## Splitting the data into training and test set
Splitting will be done for 100 times each with preserving the distribution of the compliant, non-compliant and uncertain samples in the training and test set. The splitting will be based on all country and austrian samples, separately.
### Splitting for the combined dataset

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rsample)

## check whether the rownames of y_total_cleaned are the same as the rownames of X_total_cleaned
all(rownames(y_total_cleaned) == rownames(X_total_cleaned$intact)) # TRUE
all(rownames(y_total_cleaned) == rownames(X_total_cleaned$ground)) # TRUE

# Prep the stratification column for total dataset
data_to_split_total <- y_total_cleaned %>%
  mutate(Stratify_Group = paste(DON_2, DON_4, sep = "_"))
y_total_final <- y_total_cleaned %>%
  select(
    DON = Deoxynivalenol,
    Total_DON = `Total DON`
  )


# Generate the 100 perfectly stratified splits
set.seed(123)
cv_splits <- mc_cv(data_to_split_total, prop = 0.80, times = 100, strata = Stratify_Group)

# Loop through the 100 splits
for (i in 1:nrow(cv_splits)) {
  
  # Extract the integer indices for this specific split
  train_indices <- cv_splits$splits[[i]]$in_id
  
  # Slice all matrices simultaneously
  # --- Intact Spectra ---
  X_intact_train <- X_total_cleaned$intact[train_indices, ]
  X_intact_test  <- X_total_cleaned$intact[-train_indices, ]
  
  # --- Ground Spectra ---
  X_ground_train <- X_total_cleaned$ground[train_indices, ]
  X_ground_test  <- X_total_cleaned$ground[-train_indices, ]
  
  # --- Target (Y) Data ---
  y_train <- y_total_final[train_indices, ]
  y_test  <- y_total_final[-train_indices, ]
  
  # Format the split number so files align perfectly (001, 002... 100)
  split_num <- sprintf("%03d", i)
  
  # Export all 6 files for the current iteration
  write.csv(X_intact_train, paste0("./data/train_test_set_all/X_intact_train_", split_num, ".csv"))
  write.csv(X_intact_test,  paste0("./data/train_test_set_all/X_intact_test_", split_num, ".csv"))
  
  write.csv(X_ground_train, paste0("./data/train_test_set_all/X_ground_train_", split_num, ".csv"))
  write.csv(X_ground_test,  paste0("./data/train_test_set_all/X_ground_test_", split_num, ".csv"))
  
  write.csv(y_train, paste0("./data/train_test_set_all/y_train_", split_num, ".csv"))
  write.csv(y_test,  paste0("./data/train_test_set_all/y_test_", split_num, ".csv"))
  
  # Print progress to the console
  if (i %% 10 == 0) cat("Exported full datasets for split", i, "of 100...\n")
}

cat("Finished! All 600 datasets are saved in the 'train_test_set_all' folder.\n")

```
